Says another app is using it
This shares your camera and device details with whichever AI app you pick next — nothing is sent until you choose one.
We\'ll take one quick photo and check two common settings. Not every phone brand\'s own grayscale feature can be detected this way.
Found it: Grayscale display mode is on
Your phone\'s Accessibility settings have colour correction set to grayscale. That makes everything look black and white, including the camera — turn it off and colour should come back.
Likely cause: Battery Saver is on
Many phones turn the whole screen grayscale while Battery Saver is active to save power. Turn it off (or wait until it charges) and check again.
Your last photo showed almost no colour

We checked the two most common settings and neither is on. This app can\'t see every phone brand\'s own grayscale feature (for example, some Samsung and Xiaomi phones have their own). Try restarting your phone in Safe Mode — if colour comes back there, a recently installed app is the cause. If it doesn\'t, this may need a service check.
Your last photo has normal colour
We didn\'t find a grayscale cause, and the photo itself looks fine.

Want to launch your own app or web?

1. Long-press on home screen
2. Tap 'Widgets'
3. Find 'DeviceGPT'
4. Drag to home screen

• Today's Health Score (most prominent)
• Battery % with charging status (AC/USB/Wireless)
• Battery temperature (°C)
• RAM and storage use
• With Real-time Monitor on: power (Watts), network speed (Mbps), CPU and FPS
• When it was last updated

• Updates about every 15 minutes, and each time you scan
• Real-time Monitor adds power, CPU and FPS (every 30 seconds) and a speed test on Wi-Fi about every 30 minutes
• Shows how long ago it was updated
• All data comes from real system APIs (not estimates)
💡 Tip: Tap the widget to open Health section directly!

Lock screen widgets must be added manually:

1. Lock your phone
2. Long-press on lock screen
3. Tap 'Customize' or 'Edit'
4. Tap 'Add Widget' or 'Widgets'
5. Find 'DeviceGPT'
6. Add to lock screen
